notes.title: DeathOmen Small Update - Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello my friends! 

Fixed a bug that caused the "I need to sleep" text to get stuck on the screen, requiring the player to close the game and reload the last save point to remove it.

notes.title: 💀DeathOmen Full Release💀
notes.content:
Hello horror fans

We have just launched  💀DeathOmen💀

[previewyoutube=uML24t4qU2k;full][/previewyoutube]

DeathOmen is a short psychological horror game that challenges players to maintain their sanity over the nights in a mysterious house that hides mystery and fear. It’s a journey of constant change, full of disturbing events and jump scares.

Now you can get DeathOmen for a short period with a 20% discount. Don't wait then, get it now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1842470/DeathOmen/

If you want to get the game even cheaper, check out our bundles
https://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=deathomen+bundle

Have a great time playing,
Jeff Winner

notes.title: DeathOmen Full Game?
notes.content:
Hello, my friends!

The full release is coming this Wednesday, February 5th!

Since we made the keys available on Keymailer, several streamers have tested the game while we continued updating it daily.
Since January, we've updated the game around 15 times to improve and refine the experience.

notes.title: DeathOmen Final Release Date
notes.content:
Hello horror fans

My upcoming scary horror I was working a lot lately 😱DeathOmen😱 is coming as a full release on 5th of February!

[previewyoutube=uML24t4qU2k;full][/previewyoutube]

DeathOmen is a psychological horror game that challenges players to maintain their sanity over several nights in a mysterious location where every choice leads to unrelenting mystery and fear. It’s a journey of constant change, full of disturbing events and jump scares.

I was working hard day and night to make the game as best as I could, if you like what you see, consider adding the game to your wishlist

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1842470/DeathOmen/

Have a great time playing,
Jeff Winner

notes.title: 😱Slender Reborn Full Release😱
notes.content:
Hello horror fans

I have just launched  😱Slender Reborn😱

[previewyoutube=pdbvXZbDgUQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Rediscover terror in this reimagined classic survival horror. Collect eight pages and evade the relentless Slenderman in a hauntingly realistic world rebuilt with updated graphics, adaptive AI, and immersive sound design. Prepare for unpredictable scares and a chilling atmosphere that redefines fear

Now you can get Slender Reborn for a short period of time with a 20% discount. Don't wait then, get it now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209910/Slender_Reborn/

Getting Slender Reborn now gives you a discount on buying DeathOmen, as both games will be in the bundle.

Have a great time playing,
Jeff Winner

notes.title: DeathOmen Trailer and Release Date!
notes.content:
Hello there!

I am Jeff Winner, creator of Slender Reborn and DeathOmen.

And I'm coming here on the last day of 2023 to tell you that I restarted my project after a long period of depression.

DeathOmen is coming out in January 2025

The idea is the same, I changed a few things, and the game will be low-priced, under $10, something around $6.99 and $7.99.

Here is the new trailer: [previewyoutube=inkJS_QWgSM;full][/previewyoutube]


Please share this news with your friends and wishlist the game now if you still haven't:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1842470/DeathOmen/

Happy New Year!
